To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the sport education model has the potential to enhance students' learning of sport skills, increase the likelihood of their participation in sport, and improve their attitudes toward sport and physical activity.

(1) sport education seasons are more effective than traditional seasons in promoting student learning, (2) sport education seasons provide students with more enjoyable and satisfying learning experiences, (3) sport education seasons have a positive effect on students' perceptions of their teachers' effectiveness, and (4) sport education seasons increase students' perceptions of the relevance of the physical education class.

(1) a majority of physical education teachers are not familiar with sport education; (2) the majority of physical education majors have not had any experience with sport education; and (3) the majority of teacher education programs do not offer a course in sport education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a sport education season plan.
the design and development of sport education units (or "seasons").
the development of a framework for planning sport education seasons.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sport education provides a viable alternative to the traditional physical education program and is worthy of further consideration.
the sport education model is a viable and effective approach to teaching physical education, but it is not a panacea for all that ails physical education.
the sport education model provides a viable alternative to the multi-activityapproaches currently in use in physical education.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the sport education model is an instructional approach that is based on sport, is student centered and developmentally appropriate, is a long-term unit of work, is a combination of sport and physical education, is an instructional model for teaching sport, is based on the concept of a sport season, and has an emphasis on the development of sport-specific knowledge, skills, and attitudes.
the model is an effective means of teaching sport to students.
the sport education model is the most effective way to teach physical education.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sport education model is an effective alternative to traditional, multi-activities approaches to physical education.
we can no longer afford to teach physical education in a way that is disconnected from the world outside of school.
the sport education model is a powerful tool for teaching and learning in physical education.
